# AI Assistance Declaration

I used ChatGPT (GPT-6) on November 11, 2026, for documentation planning, formatting suggestions, and code organization. I reviewed the generated content and am responsible for its accuracy. All calculations are performed using R.

# 1. Purpose

This document explains the sales_analysis.R script. The script analyzes synthetic sales data by product category and generates a summary table and bar chart.

## 2. Inputs

The script creates a synthetic dataset containing:

- order_id: Unique order identifier.
- category: Product category.
- units: Number of units sold.
- unit_price: Price per unit.

## 3. Outputs

The script generates:

- Total units sold by category.
- Total sales by category.
- Average order value by category.
- Bar chart showing total sales.

## 4. Dependencies

The project requires:

- R
- dplyr
- ggplot2

## 5. Example Code

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

sales <- data.frame(
  order_id = 1:12,
  category = rep(c("Books", "Home", "Technology"), each = 4),
  units = c(2, 1, 3, 2, 1, 2, 1, 3, 1, 2, 2, 1),
  unit_price = c(15, 20, 12, 18, 40, 35, 50, 30, 250, 180, 220, 300)
)

sales_summary <- sales %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    total_units = sum(units),
    total_sales = sum(units * unit_price),
    average_order_value = mean(units * unit_price),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sales_summary
```

## 6. Visualization

```{r sales-plot}
ggplot(sales_summary, aes(x = category, y = total_sales)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Total Synthetic Sales by Category",
    x = "Product Category",
    y = "Total Sales"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 7. Limitations

The dataset contains fictional sales records and is intended only for educational purposes. The results do not represent actual business performance.
